facts.fact: 羽茧开题：多翼成茧（living entity）——「My god, my god abandoned me...this time I am the one who does not answer.」——他跪在光的茧里，第一次不回应神。
facts.anchor: this time I am the one who does not answer.

facts.fact: 羽茧诺言：Fin 爬进茧内——「Someday, maybe we’ll be free from this constant hurt...No gods. No thrones.」「We deserve to live. Fight for that time, Nik. Fight.」——吻封茧。
射日前奏：三星聚顶、Vitae 门开——Taesia 以 Starfell 引 Nyx 之力——金光片吸收耀斑反弹向神庙（Rian 的菱形盾上一章所为）——「The portal disappeared, but the suns were still gathered together.」
facts.anchor: absorbed the attack and redirected it at the temple.

facts.fact: Ulshära 拒赐：Phos 招安（PROVE TO ME YOUR LOYALTY）——「I renounced your last 'gift' to me...I chose to burn my skin instead of carrying it on my body. The only reward I seek is freeing Solara from your negligence.」
facts.anchor: I renounced your last ‘gift’ to me,

facts.fact: Nyx 夺身二度：Nyx 强执其臂指剑 Nikolas——「He controlled her the way he had on the skybridge in Aphelion, his personal doll to pose and play with. Stop it!」——她连声音都用不了。
facts.anchor: He controlled her the way he had on the skybridge

facts.fact: 借星图反杀：黑洞视界外 astralam 幽灵（Cultris 星座）——她认出 spiritual component of Nyx's fulcrum（他唯一不能占有的东西）——找到线头一拉——Salvar/Sceleratus（星图名）——拆线反制。
绝对之黑：拆线成功——Umbra 顶剑——绝对之黑巨柱撕裂 Solara——「an eclipse in its most violent form. It was terminus—precise, severe.」——Colliding into the distant body of the Third Sun.
